overview_description.description: HappyRobot develops AI-powered software that enables businesses to deploy and manage autonomous AI workers for operational tasks. Its platform provides AI agents that handle communication, workflow execution, and process automation across enterprise operations, including logistics and other business functions. The company’s solutions integrate with existing systems to automate repetitive tasks, coordinate workflows, and support real-time operational activities.
